title: Search, discovery, favorites and ranking authority baseline
rootCause: The approved service catalog can be read from the remote services authority, but filtering, ranking, geographic eligibility and result limits are still executed in the browser.
User, Worker and publication search modes are backed by static browser pools rather than canonical server authorities.
Favorite rows have an RLS-protected schema in staging, but the product path persists favorite identifiers in localStorage and never calls public.favorites.
The domain matrix still describes favorites RLS as disabled, which no longer matches the observed staging schema.

matrixDrift.observedReality: favorites has RLS enabled with three owner-scoped policies in staging.
matrixDrift.controlledReclassification: Retire browser-local favorites authority and activate the existing remote RLS-protected authority before removing or rewriting SEARCH-B01.

blockers.actualProblem: The product persists favorites in localStorage instead of public.favorites even though staging RLS is ready.
Filtering, ranking, geographic eligibility and pagination remain browser-owned and unbounded by a server DTO.
Ranking signals, conversion telemetry and anti-manipulation controls are incomplete.

nextControlledStep: SEARCH-A02: introduce a canonical favorites repository/service over public.favorites, retire doke.service-favorites.v1 for Supabase and UUID subjects, preserve only explicit non-UUID fixture memory, and fail closed when remote authority is unavailable.
